title: Grade 2 Science — Thu, Jun 04
description: Plants Around Us — Day 4 of 5: How plants grow and what they need
subject: science

questions.question: A plant grows from a tiny:
questions.explanation: Most plants begin life as a seed, which grows into a new plant.

questions.question: Which of these does a plant need to grow?
questions.explanation: Plants need water to grow, along with sunlight, air and soil.

questions.question: Plants make their food using light from the:
questions.explanation: Plants use sunlight to make their food in their green leaves.

questions.question: A young plant that has just grown from a seed is called a:
questions.explanation: A tiny new plant that grows from a seed is called a seedling.

questions.question: What will happen to a plant that gets no water for many days?
questions.explanation: Without water, a plant dries up and wilts because it cannot make food or stay healthy.

questions.question: Plants usually grow well in:
questions.explanation: Soil holds water and food for the roots, so most plants grow well in soil.

questions.question: Which part of the seedling appears first?
questions.explanation: The root comes out of the seed first and goes down into the soil.

questions.question: Besides water and sunlight, plants also need ____ to breathe.
questions.explanation: Plants need air, just like they need water and sunlight, to live and grow.

questions.question: Why do gardeners water plants regularly?
options: So the plants get the water they need to grow
questions.explanation: Plants need water to grow, so gardeners water them regularly to keep them healthy.

questions.question: Which of these grows into a big mango tree?
questions.explanation: A mango seed, when planted, grows into a mango tree.

questions.question: A plant kept in a dark room with no light will:
questions.explanation: Without sunlight a plant cannot make food, so it becomes weak and pale.

questions.question: Roots take in water and food from the:
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil for the plant.

questions.question: Put the stages of plant growth in order: plant, seed, seedling.
questions.explanation: First there is a seed, it grows into a seedling, and the seedling grows into a full plant.

questions.question: Which of these is the BEST place to grow a healthy plant?
options: Near a sunny window with water
questions.explanation: A sunny window with water gives the plant the light and water it needs to grow well.

questions.question: Farmers grow crops like wheat by first planting the:
questions.explanation: Farmers plant seeds in the soil, which then grow into crops.
